title: A structured patch of one code package with exact replacements

status.description: done: the changes do the task; blocked: the request lacks something necessary (say what in summary and questions)

summary.description: What the changes do and why

changes.description: Every file change, each path once

path.description: Path relative to the repository root, with forward slashes

from.description: rename: the old path; null otherwise

baseBlob.description: The given blob id for modify, delete and the source of rename; null for create

content.description: Full new text for create or a full replacement; null for exact edits, delete, or rename that keeps the original text

edits.description: For a localized modify, provide exact nonoverlapping replacements against the original text and set content to null. Null for all other changes.

old.description: A nonempty excerpt found exactly once in the original file

new.description: The text that replaces old; empty to remove it
